# UtahSkis

> > Salt Lake City-based online ski and snowboard shop offering gear, apparel, and accessories from 70+ brands including Burton, The North Face, Rossignol, Smith, and Giro.

UtahSkis is powered by Ski 'N See and features Utah's widest selection of winter sports equipment with 2,500+ customer reviews and a 30-day money-back guarantee. The site serves skiers and snowboarders with comprehensive buying guides, maintenance tips, and expert advice.

- [On Sale Now](https://utahskis.com/pages/sale): Early Black Friday sale page with category-specific deals

## Buying Guides & How-Tos

- [What Kind of Skis Are Best for You](https://utahskis.com/blogs/news/skis-best-for-you): Ski type guide: frontside, all-mountain, powder, and park skis
- [Ski Poles - How to Choose](https://utahskis.com/blogs/skiing/ski-poles-buying-guide): Guide to ski pole materials, basket types, and selection criteria
- [Your Questions About Helmets Answered by Giro](https://utahskis.com/blogs/news/your-questions-about-helmets-answered-by-giro): Giro helmet FAQ covering safety, selection, and maintenance tips
- [Snowboard Maintenance Tips to Keep You Ripping All Season](https://utahskis.com/blogs/news/snowboard-maintenance-tips-to-keep-you-ripping-all-season): Snowboard care guide covering waxing, cleaning, and P-Tex repairs
- [7 Tips For Your First Ski Trip](https://utahskis.com/blogs/news/7-tips-for-your-first-ski-trip): First-timer guide to resort selection, equipment, and trip planning
